cells.n: γίνομαι in narrative context denotes occurrence/coming-to-be; 'there was' captures the existential sense better than bare 'be' for ἐγένετο + subject
LXX narrative idiom; 'be' alone would be ungrammatical here
γίνομαι in narrative past context; 'came to be' preferred over bare 'be' to express the event of coming into existence
